thread:
Jordan: Quick sync — we need to lock GA acceptance criteria for "Tiered Cost Controls" by EOD Thu. Draft checklist below; please reply with missing items or disagree/accept. Owner assignments after.

Jordan: Draft GA items:
- SLA tiers & SLO numbers (p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate)
- Pricing page copy + pricing bands + billing mapping
- Docs: migration guide, API examples, SDK flags
- Support runbook + escalation paths
- Monitoring: per-route cost per 1k tokens, burn-rate, anomalies
- Rollout plan: canary (5%), gradual 7-day ramp, automatic rollback
- Compliance/KMS: confirm key handling for Private
- Telemetry: sample payloads for billing & pricing audits

Priya: Thanks — major ask: we need explicit p99 targets per deployment mode. proposal:
```
Hosted: p99 <= 120ms
Dedicated: p99 <= 200ms (with burst exceptions)
Private: p99 <= 350ms (depends on customer infra)
Error rate < 0.5% across all tiers
```
Is that acceptable? Also need SLI definitions for tokenized vs non-tokenized requests.

Leo: Those SLOs look reasonable. Suggest adding availability SLO: 99.95% for Dedicated reserved pools and 99.9% for Hosted free-tier.

Samira: I'll own docs. Need example API requests showing tier overrides and sample migration steps for customers moving from flat pricing. Also want a short FAQ about billing disputes.

Ethan: Billing: we need to map "Tier A/B/C" to plan ids and make sure usage-export includes plan_id, effective_rate, discounts. Also confirm whether quota enforcement should be soft or hard for GA.

ops-bot: Canary run initiated for tiered-controls on prod-1, cohort=5% (id: canary-390123). Start: 2026-03-20T14:02:00Z

Jordan: Good. Action owners:
- SLA/SLO defs: Priya + Leo
- Pricing & billing mapping: Ethan
- Docs & migration: Samira
- Monitoring & alerts: Leo
- Support runbook & playbooks: Jordan + Samira
Deadline: lock everything by Thu EOD (2026-03-25). If no objections, I'll mark GA criteria as approved in the launch spreadsheet.

Priya: One more: add regression gating for quality — baseline prompts + automatic A/B quality check during canary.

Ethan: Confirming soft quota for GA (warning then hard after 7 days) unless legal asks otherwise.

Samira: +1 on QA gating. I'll add examples to the doc and a short runbook checklist for support on day 0.

Jordan: Perfect. If anyone wants to change owners speak up now or drop changes into the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/tiered-cost-controls/ga-readiness :thumbsup:

Leo: :thumbsup: will add alert thresholds and dashboard links.

ops-bot: Canary canary-390123 health=OK, latency delta +3% vs baseline, error_rate 0.2% — monitoring alerted if >1%.

Jordan: Thanks all — locking owners and criteria tomorrow morning unless major objections.
